test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **4) According to.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence in the paragraph requires a phrase to introduce the source of the information being referred to.
 
• The phrase **"According to"** is grammatically correct for introducing a source, such as a study or research article.
 
• In this case, it is used to introduce the new study published in The Journal of the American College of Cardiology, which provides evidence for the connection between food consumption and the lower risk of heart disease.

The correct sentence is: ***According to**__ a new study published in ‘The Journal of the American College of Cardiology,’*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Why the other options are incorrect:

 
• **Option 1: "According with" **– This phrase is incorrect because "according" must be followed by "to," not "with." Therefore, "according with" is grammatically wrong.
 
• **Option 2: "Accordingly"** – "Accordingly" is an adverb that indicates a result or consequence, which is not the intended meaning here. The sentence needs to refer to the source of the study, so "according to" is the appropriate choice.
 
• **Option 3: "In according with"** – This is also grammatically incorrect. The correct phrase is "according to," which is the standard expression used to reference a source.
